content.text: The service register confirms io-pay is a third-party dependency (owned by IO Payments Ltd), and logs show 503 errors from api.io-pay.example directly causing the error rate spike and latency increase. No deployment or config changes occurred in this window.

hypotheses.subject: io-pay
hypotheses.summary: io-pay (the third-party card/payment provider) began returning 503 errors starting at 22:06, which io-shop's account page depends on synchronously while rendering; this drove error rate to 100% and latency to ~2000ms p50. No deployment, config change, or internal change occurred in this window, and io-pay is explicitly a third-party dependency per the service register.

supporting_evidence.claim: account page request failed - PaymentProviderFailed: api.io-pay.example returned 503 for /v1/shoppers/shopper-3815-1-0/card at src/io_shop/payment_provider.py:95
account page error rate at 100.00% over the last minute
io-pay: third-party, owned by IO Payments Ltd, at api.io-pay.example - Holds the card Io charges. Called while the account page renders
